description: Low-level upload. Prefer the 'transfer' tool instead — it handles polling automatically. This tool returns immediately with PENDING_UPLOAD status; you must poll get_upload_status yourself. Max file size follows the account plan (Basic 500 MB / Pro 1 GB). Provide EITHER 'filePath' (local stdio only) OR 'content' (base64). Use only when you need explicit control over the upload lifecycle.No API key required — without one you upload as a guest (100 MB, 24-hour link); a key raises the limits and lets you sell.

content.description: Base64-encoded file content (standard or URL-safe base64)

fileName.description: Original filename with extension (e.g. report.pdf). Required when using 'content', optional for 'filePath' (derived from path).

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file. Only works when this MCP server runs locally (stdio transport). Preferred over base64 — zero tokens wasted.

payoutAddress.description: Wallet that a priced download pays out to. Only for running without an API key — it is what lets you sell with no account. Ignored when a key is set, because that account's payout address is a dashboard setting. Payments are final: a mistyped address is unrecoverable, and an exchange deposit address usually will not credit a Base transfer from a contract.

pricePerDownload.description: Price per download in USD (e.g. 0.50 or 0.00005). When set, downloaders pay this amount in USDC. Omit for free downloads.

name: upload_file

downloadUrl.description: Shareable download URL (works without auth, valid 24h)

status.description: Upload status: PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, READY, or FAILED

title: Upload File
